decisions.reason: This door lever handle family remains tightly aligned with the firm's core design, engineering and certification knowledge, so management would normally keep it and continue incremental refinement.
The mitred handle family is somewhat more style-specific, but it still builds on the firm's established metalworking and architectural specification capabilities, which supports retention.
The multifunctional door lever handle fits the firm's strong absorptive capacity in ergonomic, compliant and system-oriented hardware, making improvement more likely than withdrawal.
As a standard door lever handle line, it sits very close to the firm's accumulated know-how and customer channels, so the expected decision is to keep it.
This door and window handle collection has the clearest visible market validation and is highly related to the firm's existing competences, so discontinuation is very unlikely.

The light patinated bronze finish is well within the firm's in-house finishing expertise, though finishes are more fashion- and demand-sensitive than core hardware platforms, so its risk is the highest of the group but still not high.
